summary: Phase 1 Patient Records Module — full backend (14/14 pytest pass) + frontend E2E tested. Patient CRUD with India fields (mobile, aadhaar_last4, referring_doctor_id), case-insensitive search by name/mobile/patient_id, ReferringDoctor CRUD, PatientNote CRUD with cascade-on-patient-delete, sessions sorted DESC by test_date — all verified. Frontend: empty state, top-bar PatientSwitcher search + result selection, PatientModal create+edit with prefill, ReferringDoctorPicker inline-add-new+auto-select, header (name+ID+age+gender+mobile, Visit dropdown, Edit, Journal), auto-session creation for new patient, '__new__' option creates+adds visit to dropdown, Journal side drawer with AUTO 'New test session started.' entry + manual notes — all working. Visit-switching fires session GET and rehydrates state. Reports tab not fully reachable in this run due to the Escape-key drawer-dismiss bug (overlay intercepts subsequent clicks).

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Escape key does NOT close the journal side drawer; the [data-testid='patient-journal-overlay'] continues to intercept pointer events and blocks subsequent clicks (e.g., switching to a tab like Pure Tone or Reports while drawer is logically dismissed). Users must use the explicit × close button.

integration_issues.issue: The system-generated AUTO note 'New test session started.' is not yet rendered when the Journal is opened immediately after patient/session creation (race between session-create POST + auto-note POST + GET /api/patient-notes). On a subsequent visit it is correctly present. Consider: optimistically render the auto-entry locally before the GET round-trip, or await the create-note promise before opening the drawer.

action_items: Wire Escape key (and overlay click) to actually dismiss the journal drawer + remove overlay (likely a missing onClick on patient-journal-overlay or missing keydown listener).
Eliminate the create-session → auto-note race so the AUTO entry shows up on first journal open after creating a patient (await the note POST before opening, or insert into local state immediately).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: DELETE /api/patients cascades patient_notes but NOT test_sessions (intentional per docstring, 'soft archival') — verify this is the intended product behavior; orphan sessions remain queryable by their patient_id.
server.py: bare 'except:' in deserialize_datetime catches everything (incl. KeyboardInterrupt). Use 'except (ValueError, TypeError):' .
models.py is ~500 lines — consider splitting into models/patient.py, models/session.py, models/clinical.py for maintainability.
Patient search regex uses re.escape on the raw input but does not strip-validate empty/whitespace-only after escape; the current guard 'if safe' suffices but minor.
No backend index on patients.patient_id / mobile / referring_doctors.doctor_id / patient_notes.patient_id — once dataset grows, search/list/sort will scan. Add Mongo indexes.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ created during pytest run is auto-cleaned via module-scoped fixture. UI test left a real patient 'Anita Patel' (ACS-2026-3E94C28D) in DB with 2 sessions and 1 manual + 2 auto journal notes (intentional, used as fixture for visit-switch test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_patient_records.py — re-run anytime, all 14 tests should pass. Frontend testids confirmed: empty-state-new-patient (in App.js empty view), patient-search-input, patient-result-{id} (NOT patient-search-result-), patient-add-new + patient-add-new-empty, patient-modal + patient-modal-save/cancel/close, patient-field-{name|age|gender|mobile|aadhaar|address|email|dob|notes|refdoc|refdoc-input|refdoc-new-name|refdoc-new-specialty|refdoc-new-clinic|refdoc-new-phone|refdoc-new-save|refdoc-new-cancel}, patient-edit-btn, patient-journal-btn, session-select, patient-journal, patient-journal-overlay, journal-draft, journal-add. NOTE: After opening the Journal, ESC does not close it; click the explicit × (or implement overlay click-to-close) before doing further tab navigation. To reach Reports/Pure Tone: close drawer first via the × button.

rca of the issue.journal_overlay_traps_clicks: PatientJournal renders a fixed inset-0 z-40 overlay div (data-testid=patient-journal-overlay). The overlay has no onClick handler and the parent does not listen for keydown('Escape'). When the test pressed Escape, React state for 'journal open' did not flip → overlay stayed in DOM → all clicks on tabs underneath were intercepted. Fix: add onClick={onClose} to the overlay div, and useEffect(()=>{const h=e=>e.key==='Escape'&&onClose(); window.addEventListener('keydown',h); return ()=>window.removeEventListener('keydown',h);},[]).
rca of the issue.auto_note_race_on_first_open: When a new patient is created, the flow is: POST /patients → POST /sessions → POST /patient-notes (auto entry) → setState selectedPatient/selectedSession. If the user clicks Journal before the auto-note POST resolves, the GET /patient-notes?patient_id=X returns []. Mitigation: either (a) push a synthetic local note into state immediately so the UI reflects the auto-entry, or (b) await the note-create promise before flipping setSelectedPatient/setSelectedSession.
